title: Some Translation Fixes
description: Fix some hard code translations in some languages that doesn't break vanilla translation in other languages.
body:
Fix some hard code translations in some languages that doesn't break vanilla translation in other languages.</br>
I do supported other languages too, but I don't speak 7,170 languages. It's up to you to make an issue or a pull request.

This project at first started out as a Better Than Wolves addon, then now I made a stand alone version which can functional without Better Than Wolves. So shoutout to them to create a place for me to grow!</br>
I inlcude 2 ver with 2 different dependency. If you're using standalone version and having crash playing Better Than Wolves, I suggest [Legacy Fabric API fixes for BTW](https://modrinth.com/mod/legacy-fabric-api-fixes-btw).

Also, I don't have a plan port to other Minecraft versions, if you really want to, just make an issue on github.
